scope.en: Score main-paper writing on physical PDF pages 1–9, or all pages if shorter. The complete appendix is available only as auxiliary reference.
scope.zh: 核心评分针对目标 PDF 第1–9个物理页面中的正文；不足9页则全部提供。完整附录可浏览，仅作辅助参考。

quick_rules.en: Review physical pages 1–9, or all pages if the PDF is shorter. Score the main-paper writing in that window using the five shared 1–5 scales or Uncertain.
quick_rules.zh: 阅读第1–9个物理页面，不足9页则全部阅读；只评价此窗口内正文，使用五项共同的1–5分或“无法判断”。

quick_rules.en: You may browse the full PDF and appendix for auxiliary reference. References, appendices and later pages are not core-scored; reading the complete appendix is not required.
quick_rules.zh: 可浏览完整 PDF 和附录辅助理解。参考文献、附录及后续页面不计核心分；无需读完整附录才能完成。

quick_rules.en: Do not penalize text, a table or an equation continuing beyond page 9, a later conclusion, or details reasonably deferred to the appendix. Judge structure within the assigned window.
quick_rules.zh: 第9页之后续写的文字、表格、公式，窗口外结论，以及合理放入附录的细节不扣分；仅判断窗口内组织与叙述。

quick_rules.en: Judge Overall directly. PDF visual quality and optional conference-version observations are separate and never cap writing scores. Use Uncertain if a display/input problem prevents judgment.
quick_rules.zh: 总体直接判断。PDF 视觉质量和可选会议版本观察单列，不限制写作分数；显示或输入问题确实妨碍判断时选“无法判断”。

text.en: The complete target PDF remains available. Core scores concern main-paper writing within physical pages 1–9 (all pages if shorter). Appendix and reference sections are auxiliary material, even if they begin inside this window.
text.zh: 目标 PDF 可完整浏览。核心分只针对第1–9个物理页面内正文；不足9页则全部提供。附录和参考文献即使提前出现，也仅作辅助材料。

text.en: Count pages from the beginning of this PDF, including the title page, not printed proceedings numbers. The score applies to the main-paper content inside this window, not a claim about the complete article. Pages after the window remain accessible for context.
text.zh: 从 PDF 首页开始计数（含标题页），不使用印刷的论文集页码。评分只描述窗口内正文，不代表全文结论；窗口之后页面仍可用于辅助理解。

text.en: Consult an appendix when it helps explain an in-scope definition, method or reference. Do not score appendix prose, length or organization. Reasonable appendix deferral is not a structural defect; missing out-of-scope material is not proof of poor writing.
text.zh: 可按需查阅附录以理解窗口内定义、方法或引用，不评价附录文字、长度或组织。合理放入附录不等于结构缺陷，未观察范围外材料也不证明写作差。

text.en: Assess clarity, flow, in-window organization and technical explanation. Do not demand a fixed section template or figures/equations. Do not rate novelty, acceptance merit, scientific correctness, code elegance or image aesthetics.
text.zh: 评价清晰度、连贯性、窗口内组织与技术解释。不要求固定章节模板或必须有图表公式，不评价创新性、录用价值、科学正确性、代码风格或图片美观。

title.en: Scope boundary versus an input failure

text.en: The planned page-nine boundary is not a defect and does not itself require Uncertain. Unexpected missing/unreadable pages or a source-display failure are input limitations. Use a readable representation of the same source, or choose Uncertain for affected dimensions.
text.zh: 预设第9页边界不是缺陷，也不必因此选“无法判断”。非预期缺页、页面不可读或源码呈现失败属于输入限制；查阅同源可读内容，仍受阻时相关项选“无法判断”。

text.en: Rate PDF visual integrity only for pages actually inspected. After core completion, you may reveal the official PDF for a separate version audit. Neither check changes core scores automatically. Evidence and private-note panels remain absent.
text.zh: 仅对实际检查页面评价 PDF 视觉质量。核心完成后可显示官方 PDF 单独核查版本；两者均不自动改变核心分数。不增加证据或个人备注必填框。

title.en: Fresh ratings for the nine-page scope

text.en: Earlier full-scope writing, alignment and document-quality records remain separately archived. No previous scores are copied into this page-window protocol. Complete the five ratings and confirm the assigned window; no full-appendix review is required.
text.zh: 此前全文写作、对齐和文档质量记录单独保留，不复制为本协议评分。完成五项评分并确认已检查分配窗口即可，无需读完整附录。
